85: class PrivatePipeController:
86:     def __init__(self, primitives, monotonic):
87:         self.primitives = primitives
88:         self.clock = monotonic  # Fixed trusted bootstrap clock, not frame data.
89:         self.pairs = []
90: 
91:     @contextmanager
92:     def _frame_operation(self, pair):
93:         if not any(item is pair for item in self.pairs):
94:             raise PipeRefusal("owned_pipe_pair_required")
95:         with pair.lock:
96:             if pair.active or pair.closed or pair.unconfirmed:
97:                 raise PipeRefusal("pipe_frame_operation_unavailable")
98:             pair.active = True
99:         try:
100:             yield
101:         except BaseException:
102:             # A failure may follow a completed earlier chunk. Never permit a
103:             # later frame on a possibly desynchronized byte stream.
104:             self._quarantine(pair)
105:             raise
106:         finally:
107:             with pair.lock:
108:                 pair.active = False
109: 
110:     def _retire_completed(self, pair, operation):
111:         if (not operation.complete or (operation.event is not None
112:                 and (not operation.event.closed or operation.event.unconfirmed))):
113:             raise PipeRefusal("pipe_operation_still_owned")
114:         operation.buffer = None
115:         pair.operations[:] = [item for item in pair.operations if item is not operation]
116: 
117:     def _remaining_ms(self, expires):
118:         now = self.clock()
119:         if (type(expires) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(expires)
120:                 or type(now) not in (int, float) or not math.isfinite(now)):
121:             raise PipeRefusal("clock_bound")
122:         remaining = expires - now
123:         if not 0 < remaining <= 30:
124:             raise PipeRefusal("operation_deadline")
125:         return min(30000, max(1, int(math.ceil(remaining * 1000))))
126: 
127:     def _new_operation(self, pair, handle, buffer=None):
128:         p, ffi = self.primitives, self.primitives.api.ffi
129:         operation = PendingIO(handle=handle, buffer=buffer)
130:         pair.operations.append(operation)
131:         try:
132:             operation.event = p._retain(p.api.call("CreateEventW", None, 1, 0, None), "ipc-event")
133:             operation.overlapped = p.api.structure("OVERLAPPED")
134:             operation.overlapped.event = p._owned(operation.event)
135:             return operation
136:         except BaseException as original:
137:             self._quarantine(pair, operation)
138:             try:
139:                 # No I/O has been submitted. Close the event if its exact
140:                 # owner was recorded, then retire only that confirmed owner.
141:                 if operation.event is not None:
142:                     p._close(operation.event)
143:                 operation.complete = True
144:                 self._retire_completed(pair, operation)
145:             except BaseException as error:
146:                 original.add_note("Partial pipe event remains owned: " + type(error).__name__)
147:             raise
148: 
149:     def _quarantine(self, pair, operation=None):
150:         pair.unconfirmed = True
151:         if operation is not None:
152:             operation.unconfirmed = True
153:         if pair.read_set is not None:
154:             pair.read_set.unconfirmed = True
155:         if pair.worker is not None:
156:             pair.worker.unconfirmed = True
157:             if pair.role == "controller" and not pair.forced_stop_attempted:
158:                 pair.forced_stop_attempted = True
159:                 try:
160:                     # Clean shutdown refuses an uncertain worker. This distinct
161:                     # bounded route stops the retained process/job, even when
162:                     # quarantined. A process wait alone is not a clean-release
163:                     # receipt, so every uncertainty flag and buffer stays held.
164:                     pair.forced_process_stop_observed = (
165:                         self.primitives._stop_partial_worker(pair.worker, 5000) is True)
166:                 except BaseException as error:
167:                     pair.forced_stop_error_type = type(error).__name__
168: 
169:     def _cancel_and_confirm(self, operation):
170:         p, ffi = self.primitives, self.primitives.api.ffi
171:         if operation.complete or not operation.submitted:
172:             return True
173:         if operation.cancellation_attempted:
174:             return False
175:         operation.cancellation_attempted = True
176:         cancelled = p.api.call("CancelIoEx", p._owned(operation.handle), ffi.byref(operation.overlapped))
177:         error = ffi.get_last_error()
178:         if not cancelled and error != ERROR_NOT_FOUND:
179:             return False
180:         waited = p.api.call("WaitForSingleObject", p._owned(operation.event), 1000)
181:         if waited != WAIT_OBJECT_0:
182:             return False
183:         count = ffi.c_uint32()
184:         done = p.api.call("GetOverlappedResult", p._owned(operation.handle), ffi.byref(operation.overlapped), ffi.byref(count), 0)
185:         error = ffi.get_last_error()
186:         if done or error in (ERROR_OPERATION_ABORTED, ERROR_BROKEN_PIPE):
187:             # A waited exact operation may finish with a broken-pipe failure
188:             # after peer termination. That is terminal, not cancellation or
189:             # successful I/O. Keep enclosing quarantine and the raised error.
190:             operation.complete = True
191:             operation.cancelled = not bool(done) and error == ERROR_OPERATION_ABORTED
192:             operation.terminal_error = None if done else error
193:             return True
194:         return False
195: 
196:     def _finish(self, pair, operation, expires):
197:         p, ffi = self.primitives, self.primitives.api.ffi
198:         try:
199:             waited = p.api.call("WaitForSingleObject", p._owned(operation.event), self._remaining_ms(expires))
200:             if waited != WAIT_OBJECT_0:
201:                 raise PipeRefusal("overlapped_completion_not_observed")
202:             count = ffi.c_uint32()
203:             p.api.checked("GetOverlappedResult", p._owned(operation.handle), ffi.byref(operation.overlapped), ffi.byref(count), 0)
204:             operation.complete = True
205:             p._close(operation.event)
206:             self._retire_completed(pair, operation)
207:             return int(count.value)
208:         except BaseException as original:
209:             self._quarantine(pair, operation)
210:             try:
211:                 if self._cancel_and_confirm(operation):
212:                     if not operation.event.closed and not operation.event.unconfirmed:
213:                         p._close(operation.event)
214:                     self._retire_completed(pair, operation)
215:                 else:
216:                     original.add_note("Exact pipe operation cancellation is unconfirmed; owners retained")
217:             except BaseException as cleanup:
218:                 original.add_note("Pipe cleanup raised; owners retained: " + type(cleanup).__name__)
219:             raise

221:     def create_pair(self, random_name_bytes, expires):
222:         # Entropy must be generated by the future trusted bootstrap. This value
223:         # is not a provider credential and is never interpreted as a user path.
224:         if type(random_name_bytes) is not bytes or len(random_name_bytes) != 32:
225:             raise PipeRefusal("private_pipe_name_material")
226:         self._remaining_ms(expires)
227:         p, ffi = self.primitives, self.primitives.api.ffi
228:         name = "\\\\.\\pipe\\uoink-owned-" + random_name_bytes.hex()
229:         pair = PipePair()
230:         self.pairs.append(pair)
231:         operation = None
232:         try:
233:             pair.server = p._retain(p.api.call("CreateNamedPipeW", name,
234:                 PIPE_ACCESS_DUPLEX | FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED | FILE_FLAG_FIRST_PIPE_INSTANCE,
235:                 PIPE_REJECT_REMOTE_CLIENTS, 1, 32768, 32768, 5000, None), "ipc-server")
236:             operation = self._new_operation(pair, pair.server)
237:             operation.submitted = True
238:             connected = p.api.call("ConnectNamedPipe", p._owned(pair.server), ffi.byref(operation.overlapped))
239:             error = ffi.get_last_error()
240:             # No client existed before this call. An already-connected or
241:             # unexpected synchronous client is refused as a foreign race.
242:             if connected or error != ERROR_IO_PENDING:
243:                 raise PipeRefusal("unexpected_pipe_connection")
244:             pair.client = p._retain(p.api.call("CreateFileW", name, GENERIC_READ_WRITE, 0, None, 3,
245:                                                FILE_FLAG_OVERLAPPED, None), "ipc-client")
246:             self._finish(pair, operation, expires)
247:             return pair
248:         except BaseException as original:
249:             self._quarantine(pair, operation)
250:             if operation is not None and not operation.complete:
251:                 try:
252:                     if not self._cancel_and_confirm(operation):
253:                         original.add_note("Pipe connect cancellation unconfirmed; owners retained")
254:                 except BaseException as error:
255:                     original.add_note("Pipe connect cleanup raised: " + type(error).__name__)
256:             raise

258:     def attach_to_suspended_worker(self, pair, read_set, executable, arguments, working_directory, environment):
259:         if not any(item is pair for item in self.pairs) or pair.unconfirmed or pair.worker is not None:
260:             raise PipeRefusal("fresh_owned_pipe_pair_required")
261:         pair.read_set = read_set
262:         try:
263:             worker = self.primitives.create_suspended_worker(read_set, executable, arguments, working_directory,
264:                 environment, inherited_control_handles=(pair.client,), include_control_handle_argument=True)
265:             pair.worker = worker
266:             # The successful CreateProcess inherited its own duplicate. Close
267:             # this original parent client endpoint before any future resume.
268:             self.primitives._close(pair.client)
269:             return worker
270:         except BaseException as original:
271:             self._quarantine(pair)
272:             if pair.worker is not None and not pair.forced_process_stop_observed:
273:                 original.add_note("Suspended pipe worker stop unconfirmed; owners retained")
274:             raise

276:     def adopt_inherited_client(self, value):
277:         # Called only by the fixed trusted child bootstrap, before parsing any
278:         # frame. A supplied integer or FILE_TYPE_PIPE check alone is not proof
279:         # of provenance. No arbitrary handle adoption is exposed over IPC.
280:         if type(value) is not int or not 0 < value < (1 << 64) - 1 or self.pairs:
281:             raise PipeRefusal("single_inherited_endpoint_required")
282:         p, ffi = self.primitives, self.primitives.api.ffi
283:         pair = PipePair(role="worker")
284:         self.pairs.append(pair)
285:         try:
286:             pair.server = p._retain(value, "ipc-inherited-client")
287:             if p.api.call("GetFileType", p._owned(pair.server)) != 3:
288:                 raise PipeRefusal("inherited_endpoint_not_pipe")
289:             flags = ffi.c_uint32()
290:             p.api.checked("GetHandleInformation", p._owned(pair.server), ffi.byref(flags))
291:             p.api.checked("SetHandleInformation", p._owned(pair.server), 1, 0)
292:             p.api.checked("GetHandleInformation", p._owned(pair.server), ffi.byref(flags))
293:             if flags.value & 1:
294:                 raise PipeRefusal("inherited_endpoint_still_inheritable")
295:             return pair
296:         except BaseException:
297:             self._quarantine(pair)
298:             raise

300:     def _io(self, pair, writing, content_or_size, expires):
301:         if not any(item is pair for item in self.pairs) or pair.unconfirmed or pair.closed or not pair.active:
302:             raise PipeRefusal("owned_live_pipe_required")
303:         p, ffi = self.primitives, self.primitives.api.ffi
304:         if writing:
305:             if type(content_or_size) is not bytes or not 0 < len(content_or_size) <= IO_CHUNK:
306:                 raise PipeRefusal("write_chunk_bound")
307:             buffer = ffi.create_string_buffer(content_or_size, len(content_or_size))
308:             requested = len(content_or_size)
309:         else:
310:             if type(content_or_size) is not int or not 0 < content_or_size <= IO_CHUNK:
311:                 raise PipeRefusal("read_chunk_bound")
312:             requested = content_or_size
313:             buffer = ffi.create_string_buffer(requested)
314:         self._remaining_ms(expires)
315:         operation = self._new_operation(pair, pair.server, buffer)
316:         try:
317:             operation.submitted = True
318:             done = p.api.call("WriteFile" if writing else "ReadFile", p._owned(pair.server), buffer,
319:                               requested, None, ffi.byref(operation.overlapped))
320:             error = ffi.get_last_error()
321:             if not done and error != ERROR_IO_PENDING:
322:                 raise PipeRefusal("pipe_submission_failed")
323:             count = self._finish(pair, operation, expires)
324:             if not 0 < count <= requested:
325:                 raise PipeRefusal("pipe_completion_count")
326:             return count if writing else bytes(buffer.raw[:count])
327:         except BaseException as original:
328:             self._quarantine(pair, operation)
329:             if not operation.complete:
330:                 try:
331:                     if not self._cancel_and_confirm(operation):
332:                         original.add_note("Pipe I/O remains unconfirmed; buffers retained")
333:                 except BaseException as error:
334:                     original.add_note("Pipe cancellation raised: " + type(error).__name__)
335:             raise

337:     def write_bytes(self, pair, data, expires):
338:         if type(data) is not bytes or not 0 < len(data) <= HEADER.size + MAX_BODY + 32:
339:             raise PipeRefusal("frame_write_bound")
340:         with self._frame_operation(pair):
341:             offset = 0
342:             while offset < len(data):
343:                 offset += self._io(pair, True, data[offset:offset + IO_CHUNK], expires)
344: 
345:     def _read_exact(self, pair, size, expires):
346:         if type(size) is not int or not 0 < size <= HEADER.size + MAX_BODY + 32:
347:             raise PipeRefusal("frame_read_bound")
348:         chunks, received = [], 0
349:         while received < size:
350:             data = self._io(pair, False, min(IO_CHUNK, size - received), expires)
351:             received += len(data)
352:             chunks.append(data)
353:         return b"".join(chunks)
354: 
355:     def read_frame(self, pair, expires):
356:         with self._frame_operation(pair):
357:             header = self._read_exact(pair, HEADER.size, expires)
358:             _, _, _, length = HEADER.unpack(header)
359:             if not 0 < length <= MAX_BODY:
360:                 self._quarantine(pair)
361:                 raise PipeRefusal("frame_declared_length")
362:             return header + self._read_exact(pair, length + 32, expires)
363: 
364:     def read_private_bootstrap(self, pair, expires):
365:         if pair.role != "worker":
366:             raise PipeRefusal("bootstrap_reader_must_be_inherited_worker")
367:         with self._frame_operation(pair):
368:             return self._read_exact(pair, BOOTSTRAP.size, expires)
369: 
370:     def retire_endpoint(self, pair):
371:         # Child retirement means only this endpoint is closed. Only the
372:         # controller's retained process/job observation proves worker death.
373:         if not any(item is pair for item in self.pairs):
374:             raise PipeRefusal("owned_pipe_pair_required")
375:         if pair.role == "controller" and pair.worker is not None:
376:             worker = pair.worker
377:             if (not any(item is worker for item in self.primitives.workers)
378:                     or worker.unconfirmed or not worker.quiescent):
379:                 raise PipeRefusal("controller_requires_observed_worker_quiescence")
380:         with self._frame_operation(pair):
381:             if pair.operations:
382:                 raise PipeRefusal("pending_pipe_operations_retained")
383:             try:
384:                 for handle in (pair.client, pair.server):
385:                     if handle is not None and not handle.closed:
386:                         self.primitives._close(handle)
387:                 pair.closed = True
388:             except BaseException:
389:                 self._quarantine(pair)
390:                 raise

1268: def child_flow(primitives, pipes, inherited_control_value, expected_child_source_sha256, fixed_root, fixed_case):
1269:     """Same adoption prefix; one explicit generated startup binding before begin."""
1270:     _assert(fixed_case == "positive", "generated_operation_positive_adoption_only")
1271:     fixed_paths(fixed_root)
1272:     pair = pipes.adopt_inherited_client(inherited_control_value)
1273:     channel = None
1274:     adoption = InheritedReadSetAdoption(primitives)
1275:     try:
1276:         binding, key = decode_private_bootstrap(pipes.read_private_bootstrap(pair, _remaining(pipes.clock)))
1277:         _assert(binding.bootstrap_source_sha256 == expected_child_source_sha256
1278:                 and binding.namespace_sha256 == namespace_digest(), "fixed_operation_source_and_namespace")
1279:         current = primitives.api.call("GetCurrentProcess")
1280:         values = [primitives.api.structure("FILETIME") for _ in range(4)]
1281:         primitives.api.checked("GetProcessTimes", current, *(primitives.api.ffi.byref(value) for value in values))
1282:         creation = int(values[0].low) | int(values[0].high) << 32
1283:         _assert(creation == binding.process_creation_time, "child_operation_creation_binding")
1284:         channel = GenerationChannel(binding, key, "worker")
1285:         operation, payload = channel.decode(pipes.read_frame(pair, _remaining(pipes.clock)))
1286:         expected = {"generation": binding.generation_hex, "namespace_sha256": binding.namespace_sha256}
1287:         _assert(operation == "challenge" and payload == expected, "operation_challenge_binding")
1288:         pipes.write_bytes(pair, channel.encode("ready", expected), _remaining(pipes.clock))
1289:         operation, payload = channel.decode(pipes.read_frame(pair, _remaining(pipes.clock)))
1290:         _assert(operation == "adopt_readset", "owned_readset_before_operation")
1291:         adoption.adopt(payload, fixed_root, "positive", inherited_control_value, binding.manifest_sha256)
1292:         _assert(adoption.status == "adopted" and adoption.inheritance_cleared == adoption.identities_checked == 5,
1293:                 "complete_adoption_before_operation")
1294:         pipes.write_bytes(pair, channel.encode("readset_ready", operation_flow.adoption_flow.expected_adoption_response("positive")),
1295:                           _remaining(pipes.clock))
1296:         result = _bound_worker_operations(pipes, pair, channel, adoption, fixed_root)
1297:         pipes.retire_endpoint(pair)
1298:         return {"child_flow_return": 0, "adoption": adoption.receipt(), **result, "model_calls": 0}
1299:     except BaseException:
1300:         if adoption.read_set is not None:
1301:             adoption.read_set.unconfirmed = True
1302:         pipes._quarantine(pair)
1303:         raise
1304:     finally:
1305:         if channel is not None:
1306:             channel.revoke()
